about_the_game:
Desktop Pomeranian Fantasy is an idle fantasy RPG where adventures quietly unfold on your desktop.

Whether you're working, studying, or playing other games, your character automatically explores dungeons, battles monsters, and collects equipment. Open the window during a quick break, and you might find level-ups or newly discovered legendary equipment waiting for you. No manual control needed—just keep it open and enjoy a full RPG experience that progresses automatically.

Who Should Play

People who love multitasking - Progresses while you work, watch videos, or play other games, perfect for busy people

People who love watching numbers grow - Feel the satisfaction of growth through levels, stats, and equipment enhancement

Collectors - Perfect for those who want to complete a catalog of 100+ equipment items and unlock all achievements

Retro game enthusiasts - Pixel art graphics and classic RPG elements create a nostalgic atmosphere

People who want to liven up their desktop - Watch battles in a small window while working for a nice change of pace

Might Not Be For You

Action game lovers - Fully automatic, so there's zero joy from manual control

People who want instant results - This is a slow-burn experience with no instant gratification

Story-focused players - Progresses methodically with no deep narrative to expect
